'''Tiam of Gazar''' was a scholar who lived at the end of the [[Trolloc Wars]].
==History==
At the end of the Trolloc Wars, Tiam introduced the Gazaran Calendar, which marked the freedom after the wars, and recorded each year as a Free Year.{{ref/book|bwb}}
